subject.title: Feature request: Escalating stall recovery for sub-agents (nudge → kill)

question: Should #39305 stay as a subagent-specific automatic nudge-to-kill feature, be folded into the #101863 run-lifecycle reliability design, or be rejected in favor of current diagnostics-only mitigation?
rationale: The remaining work changes default runtime kill behavior, adds or avoids config/API surface, and decides user-visible failure semantics across subagents, diagnostics, gateway sessions, and chat channels.

options.title: Fold Into Lifecycle Design
options.body: Preserve #39305's production evidence and acceptance criteria as a subagent-specific requirement under #101863 so recovery, activity state, and terminal delivery share one owner model.

options.title: Ship Narrow Subagent Recovery
options.body: Implement dedicated subagent stall nudge and kill thresholds now, with focused tests and explicit compatibility/default behavior.

options.title: Keep Diagnostics Only
options.body: Decline new subagent-specific recovery and rely on current diagnostics active-abort plus manual/admin recovery, accepting the remaining chat-channel UX gap.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Lifecycle Design
recommendation.body: Preserve #39305's production evidence and acceptance criteria as a subagent-specific requirement under #101863 so recovery, activity state, and terminal delivery share one owner model.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled cross-boundary history across subagent lifecycle, recovery, and runtime product/config surfaces.
